component.name: Saldo
component.summary: Finanças pessoais a partir do Meu Pluggy

description.p: Saldo shows your bank balances, credit card limits, card bills, investments and transactions in one place, as a KDE app and a Plasma widget. The data comes from the free Meu Pluggy personal-use API.

ul.li: Overall and per-card credit limit: used and available.
Money in accounts, investments and the next card bills.
Spending by category, monthly income and expenses, balance history.
Plasma widget for the panel, the system tray or the desktop.
Credentials stored in the system keyring; data cached locally.

screenshot.caption: Overview with balances, credit limit and spending charts
Credit cards with the limit used by each one

ul.li: Bank balances, credit card limits, bills, investments and transactions from the free Meu Pluggy personal-use API
Overview with next card bills, credit limit, spending by category, income and expenses and balance history, by month
Card details with the open bill, the last closed bill and whether it was paid
Transfers between your own accounts and card bill payments are not counted as income or expenses
Plasma 6 widget for the panel or the system tray
Step-by-step guide to connect Meu Pluggy; credentials stay in the system keyring
